PIYUSH PATEL

Business Analyst | Banking & Financial Services (BFSI) | Payments | Customer Onboarding & KYC | Product Ownership

| Agile

Pune, India | +91-| 8999463735

Email:piyu1996patel@gmail.com

 | linkedin.com/in/piyushpatel0711

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Business Analyst with 7.7 years of experience in Banking & Financial Services (BFSI) and Payments, spanning retail banking, digital lending, and payments platforms. Strong domain exposure to KYC/AML compliance, customer onboarding workflows, and regulatory requirements (RBI, PCI-DSS), gained through work on core banking, digital lending, and payment reconciliation platforms. Skilled in requirement elicitation, functional specification and user story authoring, process flow design, and UAT coordination, bridging business and technology teams across Product, Engineering, QA, and Support. Experienced in Agile/Scrum and Waterfall delivery, stakeholder management, and driving business outcomes through well-defined requirements and process improvements. IIBA-CBAP trained, PSM and PSPO certified.

CC  CORE COMPETENCIES

Banking Domain: Retail Banking, Customer Onboarding, Customer Lifecycle Management, Core Banking Systems (CBS/LOS/LMS), Cards, KYC/AML & Regulatory Compliance (RBI, PCI-DSS)

Payments Domain: RTGS/NEFT/SWIFT/SEPA, Open Banking & UPI Payments, ISO 20022 & SWIFT Messaging, Fusion Payments/Global PAYplus (GPP), GLRM (Liquidity Monitoring, Position Keeping, Cash Forecasting), Payment Gateway Integration

Business Analysis: BRD, FRD, FSD, SRS, RTM, Epics, User Stories & Acceptance Criteria, Use Case Diagrams, UML, Process Flow Diagrams, Gap Analysis & AS-IS/TO-BE Mapping, Requirement Workshops & JAD Sessions

Delivery & Execution: Agile (Scrum, Kanban) & Waterfall/SDLC, Sprint Planning & Backlog Prioritization, Stakeholder Management, Cross-Functional Team Coordination (Product, Engineering, QA, Support), UAT Coordination

Tools: JIRA, Confluence, Microsoft Excel, SQL, MySQL, MS Visio, Lucid chart, Balsamiq, Wireframes, Swift CSP

PRPOFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Business Analyst

Mobikode Software Private Limited, Pune	Aug 2024 – Jul 2026 Project: Payments Platform – Finastra (UK) – Global PAYplus (GPP)

Engaged in market research, product discovery, and domain onboarding for the Global PAYplus (GPP) platform, focusing on the Global Liquidity and Risk Management (GLRM) suite.

Worked on end-to-end international and cross-border payment workflows on Finastra Global PAYplus (GPP), covering payment initiation, routing, processing, settlement, reconciliation and settlement investigations, while collaborating with business, operations and technology stakeholders.

Worked on SWIFT MT/MX message mapping and CBPR+ requirements, analyzing payment message structures and mapping requirements across SWIFT MT and ISO 20022 MX, supporting cross-border payment processing and migration-related business requirements.

Supported core banking and payment-engine integration across Finastra GPP and GLRM modules, including Liquidity Monitoring, Position Keeping, Payment Throttling, Cash Forecasting, Overdraft Control and Reconciliation, ensuring seamless integration and accurate payment/accounting flows.

Handled cross-border remittance and payment reconciliation activities, including transaction lifecycle analysis, settlement validation, payment investigations, exceptions and reconciliation, while translating business requirements into BRDs, FSDs, user stories and acceptance criteria with a strong functional BA focus.

Modernized the end-to-end lending lifecycle (LOS/LMS/CAS) for digital lending transformation platforms, integrating workflow automation with core banking systems and real-time payment processing pipelines.

Reconciliation automation: Experience with automating reconciliation workflows to reduce manual effort and improve transaction accuracy.

Designed and implemented financial analytics and fee payment platforms managing online transactions, payment reconciliation automation, and revenue reporting aligned with RBI-compliant payment gateways.

Partnered with business stakeholders to gather and document detailed functional and non-functional requirements across lending, customer onboarding, KYC, payment processing, and compliance modules.

Analyzed core GLRM modules (Real-Time Liquidity Monitoring, Position Keeping, Payment Throttling, Cash Forecasting, Overdraft Control, and Reconciliation) to build functional understanding of the payment engine.

Settlement reconciliation: Validating that transactions processed through payment rails are correctly settled and reflected in the corresponding accounts.

Studied ISO 20022 messaging standards (pacs.008, pacs.009, camt.054) and payment rails (RTGS/ACH, SWIFT GPI) to support requirement gathering and stakeholder discussions.

Worked on SWIFT payment processing and SWIFT GPI, including understanding of SWIFT-based payment flows and messaging.

Coordinated with IT teams to integrate payment gateway APIs ensuring PCI-DSS compliance, data security, and SWIFT-aligned transaction security standards.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, QA) to translate business and regulatory requirements into BRDs, process flow diagrams, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

Supported delivery governance through sprint tracking, requirement clarity sessions, and stakeholder alignment within an Agile/Scrum framework.

Business Analyst

Rankguru Technology Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore	Sep 2022 – Aug 2024 Project: Digital Banking Insights & Customer Analytics Platform, Dubai Islamic Bank (UAE)

Developed a digital analytics solution for financial clients, consolidating customer interaction data, payment transaction insights, and account health indicators into a unified reporting interface with predictive analytics.

Upgraded AEPS (Aadhaar Enabled Payment System) and core banking modules, enhancing transaction efficiency, payment settlement processing, and regulatory compliance.

Defined business and functional requirements for customer onboarding, payment transaction processing, reconciliation, and settlement systems aligned with NPCI and RBI guidelines.

Performed gap analysis between legacy and proposed core banking system (CBS) modules to improve NEFT/RTGS transaction processing and operational performance.

Designed wireframes, mockups, and process flow diagrams for dashboards integrating account performance, KYC/AML compliance, and digital payment behavior analytics.

Partnered with data engineering teams to validate data lineage, ETL mappings, and business rule logic for financial and payment insights.

Conducted UAT sessions, root cause analysis, and change request management ensuring compliance with open banking standards and business objectives.

Delivered BRD, RTM, and FSD documentation ensuring complete traceability and stakeholder sign-off at each phase.

Coordinated with Product, Engineering, QA and Support teams to ensure requirements, UAT outcomes, reconciliation processes and compliance checks were ready before implementation/go-live.

Release Sign-off: Supported UAT coordination, defect/RCA tracking and stakeholder signoffs, ensuring business requirements and acceptance criteria were completed before release.

Business Analyst

Think & Learn Pvt. Ltd. (BYJU'S), Pune	Nov 2021 – Aug 2022 Client: Bank of America (USA)

Conducted requirement gathering for CRM data flow, payment status updates, and financial reporting automation.

Collaborated with finance and tech teams to ensure end-to-end data accuracy across multiple payment gateways and reconciliation processes.

Designed and implemented reporting dashboards for visibility into customer payment statuses, conversions, and revenue tracking.

Supported UAT and ensured compliance with data security, PCI-DSS, and privacy policies.

Reconciliation & settlement: Worked on post-transaction activities including payment reconciliation, settlement processing, and exception identification across payment and banking systems.

Payment reporting & exception handling: Supported payment status validation, reconciliation reporting, fee/revenue reporting, and resolution of transaction discrepancies in coordination with business and technology teams.

Business Analyst

Lupin Ltd., Pune	Oct 2020 – Nov 2021

Project: Treasury Management & Compliance Automation, Citibank (USA)

Collected and documented business requirements for treasury operations, cash flow management, fund transfers, and investment monitoring.

Worked with IT to automate RBI/SEBI-compliant regulatory reporting and reconciliation workflows.

Developed BRD, SRS, and process flow documents covering transaction lifecycle, payment settlement, and reconciliation processes.

Supported UAT and coordinated signoffs from business and audit stakeholders.

Payment Returns: Experience handling returned/rejected payment transactions, return processing, reason-code analysis, and ensuring returned funds are correctly reconciled and posted.

Payment Investigations: Experience investigating failed, delayed, or disputed payments by tracing transactions across payment rails/core banking systems, identifying root causes, and coordinating resolution with operations/technology teams.

Business Analyst

IPCA Laboratories Ltd., Pune	Jan 2019 – Oct 2020

Project: Banking Reconciliation & ERP Integration Project, Wells Fargo (USA)

Gathered requirements for bank reconciliation, ledger management, and automated financial reporting.

Partnered with finance and IT teams to map data fields between ERP and bank systems, supporting NEFT/RTGS transaction reconciliation.

Designed data flow diagrams ensuring data accuracy during system migration and integration.

Supported post-go-live monitoring and KPI reporting to senior management.

  EDUCATION

 Master of Business Administration (MBA) – Marketing | RMD Sinhgad School of Management Studies, Pune2020

 CERTIFICATIONS

Certified Business Analyst Professional – TrainSmart Academy

Certified Agile Professional – TrainSmart Academy

Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) – Scrum.org

Professional Scrum Master (PSM) – Scrum.org

Six Sigma White Belt – 6sigmastudy

Jira Fundamentals – Simplilearn

SQL Fundamentals – Sololearn

Digital Skills: User Experience – Accenture
